# #2850: Patch: cull the redundant cases in the web's largest route and deckbuilder tests
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### Kind

Architecture

### Why

This is #1125's pattern 2, the redundant tests, applied to the web's largest test files after the cue tables (#2849). Each of these files has 70 to 140 cases. Files that size tend to collect several `it`s that render the same component in the same state and assert overlapping things, cases that test a mock rather than the code, and cases that re-prove a helper which has its own unit test.

### What to change

In these eight files only (each count is approximate):

| File | Cases |
|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/routes/practice.test.tsx` | 139 |
| `apps/web/src/routes/login-flows.test.tsx` | 95 |
| `apps/web/src/audio/engine.test.ts` | 91 |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx` | 79 |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/browse.test.tsx` | 78 |
| `apps/web/src/game/actions.test.ts` | 71 |
| `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/inspect.test.tsx` | 71 |
| `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` | 70 |

- **Delete** an `it` whose assertions are a subset of another `it` in the same file that sets up the same state.
- **Delete** an `it` that asserts only what its own mock returns.
- **Delete** an `it` that re-proves a pure helper, when the helper's own `*.test.ts` already covers the same input.
- **Fold** near-identical cases into `it.each` where they differ only by input.
- **Keep** any `it` whose title holds an R-id as a word (CLAUDE.md rule 3), unless that ruling's `proven_in` keeps another proof. Also keep any `it` that is the only test of a UI path a player can reach (a route, a button, an error state).

Out of scope: every other file. That includes `CardFace.test.tsx` and `filters.test.ts` (#2846's), the cue tests (#2849's), `apps/web/src/test/daily.ts` and `e2e/`.

### Acceptance

- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` and `cargo jackioh spec check` are green.
- Only the listed files change.
- The PR gives the case counts before and after for each file, and gives one line per deleted case naming the test that still covers it.

### Blocked by, part of

None. Follows #1125. Siblings: #2846, #2847, #2848, #2849.

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium: one app, eight files, case-by-case judgment.

### Priority

No priority

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41488431394)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Cull redundant cases in the eight listed web test files only: delete an `it` whose assertions are a subset of another `it` in the same file with the same setup, delete an `it` that re-proves the pure helper `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/filters.ts` where `filters.test.ts` covers the same behavior and input class (the UI renders `visiblePool()` directly, verified in `DeckEditor.tsx`), and fold near-identical cases into `it.each`/loops. No R-titled `it` is deleted (one R192 case moves its input into another R192 `it` in the same file). Target: 694 cases before → 641 after, counted with `grep -cE '^\s*(it|test)(\.each)?\(' <file>`.

## Files to touch

| File | Change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/routes/practice.test.tsx` | change | Fold fallback trio (486/495/504) and pending/banned pair (617/626); delete 813 into 518 |
| `apps/web/src/routes/login-flows.test.tsx` | change | Delete 636 into 655's answer table |
| `apps/web/src/audio/engine.test.ts` | change | Delete 488; fold 798/808 |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.test.tsx` | change | Fold deck/trio pairs (685,796), (711,816), (722,826), (738,833); fold 1501/1525 |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/browse.test.tsx` | change | 18 deletions (below), 1 merge, 3 folds |
| `apps/web/src/game/actions.test.ts` | change | Fold ignores block; fold 567/615; delete 914 |
| `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/inspect.test.tsx` | change | Delete 787; 5 folds |
| `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` | change | Delete 154; 2 folds; merge 666 into 677 |

Touch nothing else: not `filters.test.ts` (only read as the covering proof), not `CardFace.test.tsx`, cue tests, `test/daily.ts`, `e2e/`, not `spec/` (no ruling added, cited, or renumbered; no `proven_in` edit needed). Governing spec: none beyond CLAUDE.md rule 3 (R-ids in titles stay green under `spec check`).

## Steps

1. `practice.test.tsx`: fold 486/495/504 into one loop (file already uses `for…cleanup()` loops, copy 655's shape) titled `B32 a saved setup that cannot be read falls back to easy`, rows: set `"{{not json"`, set nightmare-difficulty JSON, throw from `getItem`/`setItem`; keep expects (setup shown, easy checked).
2. Same file: fold 617/626 into a loop over `["pending","banned"]` titled `B32 a pending or banned account gets no saved decks`, keeping both expects.
3. Same file: add `expect(screen.queryByTestId(T.deckHint)).toBeNull();` to 518 after its `waitFor`, then delete 813 (same active+SAVED state; 518 already proves the options, 813 only added the null hint).
4. `login-flows.test.tsx`: add `{ status: 429, body: { error_code: "over_email_send_rate_limit", msg: PROVIDER_MSG } }` to 655's answer array plus `expect(bodyText()).not.toContain(PROVIDER_MSG);` in its loop, then delete 636. R192 stays proven by 655 in the same file.
5. `engine.test.ts`: delete 488; the B46 `while suspended` row proves acceptance, logging, flagging, and no node/fetch with stronger asserts.
6. Same file: fold 798/808 into `it.each` over `[{defId:"core-005",line:"cast",delay:150,fetch:"ok"},{defId:"core-004",line:"death",delay:0,fetch:"reject"}]` titled `B9 with no speech port a line that cannot be heard ends failed, and nothing throws`; set `r.fetch.mode="reject"` only for the reject row; expect `outcome:"failed"`.
7. `DeckWorkshop.test.tsx`: fold each deck/trio pair into `it.each([["deck",…],["trio",…]])` keeping `R2119000` in the title: (685,796) takeoff rows/toast, (711,816) window-end exact-once calls, (722,826) pagehide keepalive, (738,833) refused-restore rows; table carries mount args, delete testid, op/id, toast text.
8. Same file: fold 1501/1525 into `it.each([["history"],["cosmetics"]])` titled `R2127000 one Back closes the deck panel and the page stays on /decks; after Escape, one Back leaves`; history branch mounts with server versions and waits for rows, cosmetics branch clicks the cosmetics button; common Back/Escape/Back asserts unchanged.
9. `browse.test.tsx` deletions, each covered as named: 525 by 517 (empty UI, stronger); 573 by filters `matches the name, ignoring case`; 579 by `matches the radiant text`; 585 by `matches a printed keyword kind…`; 593 by `matches a tag` + `matches the rarity`; 601 by `the query is trimmed…`; 614 by `one term that occurs nowhere…`; 468 by `cost 6+ holds 6 and 100`; 475 by `cost X holds only the X card`; 482 by `an embiggen card is found under its base price…`; 491 by `chips in one group OR together`; 499 by `groups AND together`; 511 by `a Trap chip does not take Field Traps…`; 367 by `never offers a token, even an owned one`; 696 by `there are seven sort keys, and the default sort is cost ascending`; 723 by `cards without stats go last…`; 926 by `counts a deck's cards per bucket…`. Wiring stays via 566/607/620/517/533/705/630/935/948.
10. Same file: append 669's click-disabled-noop expects to 662, delete 669; merge 959+965 into one `it` (same `mount(["x-01"])`, both badge asserts); append 999's keyboard half to 991, delete 999; fold 1033+1043 into `it.each` over the holder (`compared deck` mount+compareWith vs `open deck` mount-held), using 1033's disabled-plus-adds-nothing body for both.
11. `actions.test.ts`: fold 163/173/184/194/206/629 into one `it.each` table (legal array, start built as idle / playing via hand-click on h1 / attacking via unit-click on u1, click target, expected interaction); title `ignores an illegal click: nothing is sent and the interaction is unchanged`; all use `seatedView()`.
12. Same file: fold 567+615 into `it.each` over the two legal arrays with the shared deselect body; delete 914 (subset of 712: `answerAction` defaults `legal` to `[]`, so `[]` and omitted take the identical reconstruction path — verified in `actions.ts`).
13. `inspect.test.tsx`: delete 787 (byte-identical asserts to 888, which also keeps the R2617000 proof); fold 310+317 into `it.each` over `["pen", undefined]` pointer kinds; fold 473/479/485 into the file's existing `for…it` pattern (copy 1005's shape) with per-path fire (Escape keyDown / `blur(window)` / scroll on scroller); keep 492 (visibility setup differs).
14. Same file: fold 983/990/997 into the same `for…it` pattern (close / scrim / Escape + focus-back expects); fold 1127/1141/1157 into `it.each` over containers with opener table (hover / `openSheetBy` / direct `CardDetail` render) asserting `expectFenceUntouched`; fold 798+808 into a loop over the disarm (`advance(CLICK_SUPPRESS_MS)` vs touch press+lift) then click → called once.
15. `match.test.tsx`: delete 154 (subset of 132: same legal-endTurn state, 132 adds the click→`action` wire); fold 1175+1187 into `it.each` over `seriesIn("playing")`/`seriesIn("over")`; fold 775+785 into `it.each` over `[[withStreaks(N-1,0),"Ranked match"],[withStreaks(N+1,N+1,false),"Unranked match"]]` keeping `R2101000` in the title; add 666's `Max#3 (you) Normal Grape III` banner expect to 677, delete 666.

## Tests

- After each file: `pnpm --dir apps/web test <file>` (e.g. `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/match.test.tsx`).
- Then: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- Counts: run the Goal's grep per file; expect practice 139→135, login 95→94, engine 91→89, workshop 79→74, browse 78→57, actions 71→64, inspect 71→62, match 70→66.

## Done when

- [ ] Only the eight files differ (`git status --porcelain` shows nothing else).
- [ ] Per-file case counts before/after recorded as above.
- [ ] PR description gives one line per deleted case naming its covering test (steps 3–6, 9–13, 15).
- [ ] All four acceptance checks green; every R-id title kept (R2479000 untouched — sole proof; R192 still proven in-file).

## Risks

- Browse pattern-3 deletions rest proof on `filters.test.ts`; mitigated by keeping one UI-wiring proof per group and because `DeckEditor` renders `visiblePool()` unmodified.
- Folded `it.each` tables must keep R-ids (`R2101000`, `R2119000`, `R2127000`) and B-ids in titles so `spec check` and triage still match.
- Kept deliberately: helper own-tests (704, 914's killer 712, 2447, glossary block — no dedicated helper test exists), sole-UI-path proofs (205, 2522, 2729, 882, 914's neighbors), boundary cases (524/537, 714, 821/840), negative controls (1737, 1226).

## Open questions

None blocking. Judgment call recorded: pattern 3's "same input" read as same behavior and input class (helper and UI fixtures differ by id), since a literal same-bytes reading would make the browse B31/B32 cull unimplementable; the rejected alternative was keeping all UI-semantic duplicates.
